tldr: 台股在AI獲利熱潮推升下，維持在45,300點附近的高檔區間。
台積電AI營收朝兆元邁進、訂單能見度到2028年，CoWoS先進封裝持續供不應求。
金管會為壽險新清償制度提供過渡減壓，國際私人銀行則搶攻台灣約8兆美元的財管市場。

items.title_zh: 台股攻上45,300點高檔 AI行情撐盤
items.title_en: TAIEX holds near record highs around 45,300 on AI momentum
items.summary_zh: 台股加權指數維持在約45,300點的高檔區、逼近歷史高點，AI帶動的獲利成長推升半導體與硬體權值股，指數權王台積電站上約2,380元。從AI伺服器到先進封裝的晶片供應鏈需求成為盤面主要支撐；上半年出口強勁強化多頭氣勢，但偏高的評價也使市場對AI訂單任何降溫較為敏感。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index is trading near the 45,300 level, close to record territory, as an AI-driven earnings boom lifts semiconductor and hardware heavyweights. Index leader TSMC sits near NT$2,380 after a firm session, while demand across the chip supply chain — from AI servers to advanced packaging — underpins sentiment. Strong first-half exports reinforce the bull case, though rich valuations leave the market sensitive to any cooling in AI orders.

items.title_zh: 大摩看好2026 AI半導體 點名台積電等5檔
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley stays bullish on 2026 AI chips, spotlights TSMC
items.summary_zh: 摩根士丹利維持對2026年AI半導體循環的正向看法，點名台積電及散熱、記憶體等個股並給出目標價。大摩認為AI需求正從GPU向散熱、電源與高頻寬記憶體擴散，可望延續台廠供應鏈的接單動能。這份報告延續近期賣方偏多論調，也是晶片權值股在獲利了結壓力下仍獲買盤支撐的原因之一。
items.summary_en: Morgan Stanley reiterated a constructive view on the 2026 AI semiconductor cycle, naming TSMC alongside thermal-management and memory stocks with fresh target prices. The broker argues AI demand is broadening beyond GPUs into cooling, power and high-bandwidth memory, sustaining order momentum for Taiwan's supply chain. The call adds to a run of bullish sell-side commentary that has kept chip leaders bid despite periodic profit-taking.

items.title_zh: 台積電AI營收衝兆元 訂單能見度直達2028年
items.title_en: TSMC's AI revenue scales toward NT$1 trillion, visibility to 2028
items.summary_zh: 台積電AI相關營收有望朝兆元（新台幣）規模邁進，公司表示訂單能見度已延伸至2028年。輝達、超微、博通等大客戶推動AI晶片需求倍數成長，帶動台積電美元營收持續站穩千億美元之上。長天期的能見度凸顯台灣龍頭晶圓代工廠在全球AI建置浪潮中的關鍵地位。
items.summary_en: TSMC's AI-related revenue is on track to scale toward the trillion-NT-dollar mark, with management citing order visibility that now extends to 2028. Demand from Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom is driving multiples of growth in AI silicon, helping keep the foundry's US-dollar revenue above the US$100 billion threshold. The long visibility underscores how central Taiwan's leading foundry has become to the global AI build-out.

items.title_zh: 台積電CoWoS訂單爆滿 後段傳由英特爾馬來西亞廠支援
items.title_en: TSMC CoWoS packaging stays sold out; Intel Malaysia reportedly helps
items.summary_zh: 台積電CoWoS先進封裝產能持續供不應求，外溢的後段訂單傳由英特爾馬來西亞廠協助消化以紓解瓶頸。隨AI加速器對封裝需求攀升，CoWoS月產能預估將持續大幅擴充。產能吃緊凸顯先進封裝已成AI硬體供應鏈的關鍵瓶頸與獲利池所在。
items.summary_en: TSMC's CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity remains sold out, and overflow back-end work is reportedly being routed to Intel's Malaysia site to ease the bottleneck. Monthly CoWoS capacity is projected to keep climbing sharply into 2027 as AI accelerators demand ever more packaging. The tightness highlights advanced packaging as the key chokepoint — and profit pool — in the AI hardware chain.

items.title_zh: 接軌TIS過渡措施 8壽險型金控資本減壓
items.title_en: FSC grants capital relief to ease insurers' TIS transition
items.summary_zh: 為協助壽險業平順接軌2026年上路的新一代清償能力制度（TIS/ICS），金管會給予8家壽險型金控資本減壓，另11家保險型金控可延後一個月申報資本適足率。措施旨在避免業者轉採公允價值衡量保險負債時出現資本衝擊，也反映監理機關對制度分階段、穩健落實的重視。
items.summary_en: To smooth the shift to Taiwan's new insurance capital regime (TIS/ICS) taking effect in 2026, the FSC is granting capital relief to eight life-insurance-heavy financial holding companies, while eleven insurance-type FHCs may defer their capital-adequacy filing by a month. The measures aim to prevent a capital shock as insurers move to fair-value liability measurement, and reflect regulators' emphasis on an orderly, phased rollout.

items.title_zh: 金管會8項新制 壽險業迎大轉型
items.title_en: FSC's slate of new insurance rules ushers in a major transformation
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布多項明年上路的保險業新制，重點是IFRS 17與新清償能力制度將重塑壽險商品與資產負債結構，帶動壽險業大轉型。公允價值會計下，業者預料將強化資產負債管理並增加保障型商品比重。這波監理改革是台灣保險業近年最大結構性變革之一。
items.summary_en: The FSC has outlined a set of new insurance-sector rules taking effect next year, headlining a major transformation for life insurers as IFRS 17 and the new solvency regime reshape products and balance sheets. Under fair-value accounting, insurers are expected to strengthen asset-liability management and tilt toward protection-type products. The overhaul marks one of the biggest structural shifts for Taiwan's insurance industry in years.

items.title_zh: 瑞銀、滙豐搶攻台灣8兆美元財管市場
items.title_en: Global banks step up push into Taiwan's ~US$8tn wealth market
items.summary_zh: 瑞銀、滙豐、法國巴黎銀行等國際私人銀行加碼進軍台灣約8兆美元的財富管理市場，看中高資產與超高資產族群的快速成長。台灣推動亞洲資產管理中心、放寬服務逾新台幣1億元客戶的規定，擴大了商機。私人銀行、信託與跨境商品平台的競爭正日益激烈。
items.summary_en: Global private banks including UBS, HSBC and BNP Paribas are intensifying their drive into Taiwan's roughly US$8 trillion wealth-management market, drawn by fast-growing high- and ultra-high-net-worth wealth. Taiwan's push to build an Asian asset-management hub and eased rules for serving clients above NT$100 million are widening the opportunity. Competition is heating up across private banking, trusts and cross-border product platforms.

items.title_zh: KPMG報告：台灣高資產客群年複合成長約10%
items.title_en: KPMG: Taiwan's high-net-worth segment to grow ~10% a year to 2029
items.summary_zh: KPMG《2026台灣財富管理報告》預估，至2029年高資產客群年複合成長率約10%，其中超高資產族群成長最快、約11%。報告指出傳承規劃、信託與結構型商品是主要需求驅動力，並建議銀行深化顧問能力，以鞏固台灣作為區域財富中心的地位。
items.summary_en: KPMG's 2026 Taiwan Wealth Management Report projects the high-net-worth segment to grow at roughly a 10% compound annual rate through 2029, with the ultra-high-net-worth tier expanding fastest at about 11%. The report points to succession planning, trusts and structured products as key demand drivers, and urges banks to deepen advisory capabilities as Taiwan cements its role as a regional wealth center.
